name: Food Recipe Ingredient Substitution ODP Pattern
description: Diagram (this article has no graphical representation)
competency_questions: Which recipe does a given ingredient substitution apply to, and does the substitution change the ingredient list, the preparation steps, or both?; What requirement does a given ingredient substitution have to satisfy - a diet, a cultural restriction, or a limit on how the food can be prepared - and what is the substitution meant to achieve?; How much of which food does a recipe call for, and which qualities of that food are recorded: how it tastes, how it fits a diet, or how it behaves when cooked?
